title: SunSheep's Home
description:
新增了一个蓝白色系的房子，可以用于入住！
A new blue and white house has been added, which can be used for occupancy!
body:
新增了一个蓝白色系的房子，可以用于入住！
A new blue and white house has been added, which can be used for occupancy!
在其中会有两个箱子与大量的工作方块，在房屋旁边会有一个水池和一些羊。
There will be two boxes and a large number of work blocks inside, and there will be a pool and some sheep next to the house.
其中还有一张淡蓝色床以供夜晚休息。
There is also a light blue bed for resting at night.
